name: nba-r
description: HyperFrames workspace for NBA matchup videos

scripts.render: npm run build && hyperframes render . -o out/celtics-76ers-preview.raw.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -i out/celtics-76ers-preview.raw.mp4 -map 0:v:0 -map 0:a:0 -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-16:TP=-1.5:LRA=11:linear=false -c:a aac -b:a 192k -ar 48000 -movflags +faststart out/celtics-76ers-preview.mp4
scripts.lint: npm run check:assets && tsc --noEmit && hyperframes lint .

author: farmcan
